comparison.objective: Seat a keyed coupling and prove rotary drive transfer; candidate adjusts damping and proves stopping performance.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed alignment, insertion, and rotational engagement versus hex-key unlocking, collar tuning, relocking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Continuous coupling engagement with lower-rotor motion and no direct drive versus bounded stroke, impact energy/velocity, rebound, overload, and drift over two cycles. Coupling record lacks numeric seating/transfer thresholds.
comparison.reason: Both verify a mechanism after manipulation, but the core insertion/drive-transfer ability differs from iterative dynamic tuning.
